passage.label: Ibrahim said to father and people I am disassociated from what you worship except He who created me He will guide me; made it a word remaining among descendants that they might return; gave enjoyment to these and their fathers until truth and clear Messenger came; when truth came said magic disbelievers; why not sent down upon great man from two cities; distribute mercy Lord apportioned livelihood raised some above others degrees use one another service mercy Lord better than accumulate; if not people become one community made disbelievers houses ceilings stairways silver mount; doors couches silver recline; gold ornament all not but enjoyment worldly life Hereafter Lord righteous; blinded remembrance Most Merciful appoint devil companion; devils avert way think rightly guided; comes Us says wish distance east west wretched companion; never benefit Day wronged sharing punishment; make deaf hear guide blind clear error; whether take you away take retribution upon them; show promised Perfect Ability; adhere revealed straight path; remembrance you people questioned; ask messengers before made besides Most Merciful deities worshipped

arabicExcerpts.text: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِي بَرَآءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهۡدِينِ
وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةٗ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ

أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضٗا سُخۡرِيّٗاۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
وَلَوۡلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَن يَكۡفُرُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمۡ سُقُفٗا مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُونَ
وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
وَزُخۡرُفٗاۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَيۡطَٰنٗا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٞ
وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ
وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ
فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرٞ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ
وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةٗ يُعۡبَدُونَ

mainSubject.label: Ibrahim's disassociation from his people's worship save the Creator who guides, established as a lasting word among his descendants for their return; prolonged enjoyment granted until the truth and clear Messenger arrived, dismissed as magic; the demand for a great man from the two cities answered by the question of distributing divine mercy, which is apportioned through differentiated livelihoods enabling mutual service, surpassing all accumulation; silver ceilings, stairways, doors, couches and gold ornament withheld only to prevent unified disbelief, being mere worldly enjoyment against the Hereafter for the righteous; blindness to the Rahman's remembrance earning a devil-companion who averts while seeming to guide, producing the east-west regret at meeting; shared punishment availing nothing; prophetic inability to make the deaf hear or the blind see; death or demonstration both covered by perfect ability; adherence to the straight path named remembrance and subject to questioning; the challenge to ask prior messengers whether deities beside the Rahman were ever appointed

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: So adhere to that which is revealed to you; indeed you are on a straight path.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةٗ يُعۡبَدُونَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Ask those We sent before you of Our messengers whether We made deities besides the Rahman to be worshipped.

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the deniers' retribution (25) before Ibrahim's disassociation opens (26); P2 ends with the challenge to ask prior messengers (45); P3 runs through the Musa-Pharaoh narrative and Isa-as-example block closing with the sudden Hour (66); P4 covers the righteous-friends exception through the truth-aversion notice (67-78); P5 begins with their plotting and closes with the turn-aside-and-peace instruction (79-89).
